messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)

Your order Shop···· is paid, and your Magic M. 40T hasn't shipped yet. I'm sorry about the wait. We gave dates on this miner that we didn't keep, and we haven't kept people updated the way we should have.

Here's where it stands now. The factory expects to ship the units out on November 12. As soon as your miner ships to you, we'll email you the tracking. You can also follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
